subject: Exploring low-volume commit plans and price bands for hosted usage
messages:
From: Olivia Tan <olivia@paygrid.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@paygrid.com
Date: 2025-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — low upfront commit options?

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — PayGrid loved the latency profile and the built-in caching examples. We’re an early-stage payments startup and we’re evaluating Redwood for a feature flagged rollout (approx. 10k-50k tokens / month to start).

Before we get legal involved, can you confirm whether Redwood supports a monthly minimum below the standard committed blocks? Specifically: can we do a small monthly commit (e.g., $1k–$3k/mo) with overage billing, or does hosted require a larger baseline? Also curious about whether credits roll or if unused commit is forfeited month-to-month.

Would appreciate a short note on options and any startup-friendly packaging.

—Olivia
Olivia Tan
Head of Product
PayGrid
olivia@paygrid.com

Attachments: none

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — low upfront commit options?

Hi Olivia — great to hear PayGrid found the demo useful. Short answer: yes, we can support lower-commit monthly plans on hosted, but terms differ from our standard reserved capacity blocks. A few quick notes below; I’ll loop in Marissa for commercial options and Neha for procurement details.

High-level options we typically offer for early-stage customers:
- Micro-commit (starter tier): $1,000/mo committed credit, billed monthly. Unused credits roll for up to 30 days and then expire. Overage charged at list rate (per-token).
- Flex-commit: $0 upfront, pay-as-you-go with a soft minimum of $500/mo for contract purposes, but no enforced resource reservation — suitable for low predictable volume.
- Quarterly prepay: we can pro-rate a 3-month small commit (e.g., $3k total) and apply a 10% prepay discount.

Things to watch: micro-commits do not include SLA credits and have limited priority routing; moving to Dedicated later is possible but requires a migration plan and minimum reserved capacity.

Marissa — can you outline pricing tiers and any current startup promotions? Neha — procurement checklist / PO flow for small commits?

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Manager, Hosted
Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-11-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — low upfront commit options?

Hi Olivia — thanks for the question. Adding concrete rate examples below so you can run math against expected token usage. Attached: redwood-ratecard-v1.pdf and a short comparison table.

Starter (Micro-commit) — $1,000/mo
- Effective per-token rate: $0.0008/token for standard text gen workloads (up to 1M tokens).
- Unused credit expiry: 30 days.
- SLA: standard best-effort (no financial SLA).
- Support: community + email; 48-72h response for non-critical.

Flex-commit (no up-front) — $0/mo baseline, pay-as-you-go
- Per-token list rate: $0.0012/token
- Billing min: $500/mo contractual for ease of procurement (we can set billing threshold).
- Overages: measured monthly and invoiced net-30.

Quarterly prepay (3-month) — $2,700 (3 x $900 equivalent)
- Applied discount: 10% off list; credits applied monthly; credits do not expire during the prepay term.

Notes / negotiable items:
- Startup promotion: we can apply a one-time 15% discount for the first 2 months subject to marketing reference (mutual).
- Migration credit: if PayGrid moves to Dedicated within 12 months and signs a 12-month reserved contract, we can apply up to one month of hosted spend as credit toward the Dedicated onboarding fee (T&Cs apply).

Olivia — happy to hop on a quick call and run a few pricing scenarios if you can share expected token mix (chat vs embeddings), peak QPS, and whether you need PCI/PII-sensitive routing today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-ratecard-v1.pdf, paygrid-procurement-questions.xlsx

From: Olivia Tan <olivia@paygrid.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — low upfront commit options?

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Token mix: roughly 80% short chat replies (~30 tokens per call) and 20% occasional embeddings (200–300 dims) for search. Est. ~20k tokens/mo to start.
2) Compliance: we do not need PCI at launch but want to ensure logs/data retention policies are clear.
3) Paperwork: procurement typically requires a PO and 30-day payment terms. Would a Flex-commit plan with a $500 contractual minimum satisfy that? If so, we could start immediately and upgrade if usage grows.

A couple of asks: can you confirm whether the micro-commit $1k plan can be pro-rated mid-month if we sign on the 15th? Also, for the startup promotion, what constitutes a "marketing reference"?

—Olivia

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia@paygrid.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — low upfront commit options?

Hi Olivia — quick procurement answers below: feel free to loop in your procurement contact and I’ll send a lightweight SOW/Order Form draft.

• Pro-rating: yes — we pro-rate any commit that starts mid-billing-cycle; your first invoice would show a pro-rated charged amount for the remainder of that billing month.
• PO + Net-30: acceptable on Flex-commit and Micro-commit plans. We’ll issue invoices monthly and accept PO numbers on the invoice.
• Marketing reference: a short one-paragraph case study or a logo+quote we can publish on our site; if privacy concerns exist, we accept an anonymized quote or a 6-month delayed publication.
• Security / logs: hosted API includes an audit log stream for API calls (30-day retention by default); extended retention and log delivery to a customer S3 are available as paid add-ons.

Next steps: if PayGrid is comfortable, I’ll prepare the Order Form for a Flex-commit with a $500 contractual minimum and Net-30 billing; we’ll include the 1-month 15% startup discount as a promotional credit if you agree to the marketing reference.

If that sounds good, please reply with a bill-to PO number and we’ll kick off contracting.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurements Specialist
Redwood Inference
